changes.event: field entry ruled standing with a bound (stage D3 section 4, rule 11): tentative since C4a, now counted in the rooms' own lines
changes.why: Stage D3 section 4 rules the field's tentative entries by the rooms' lines. A21 drew 708 lines in 705 rooms, every one ruled at D3a-27 by G32 (written before any line was ruled), with G2, G3, G9, G4a and G31. In 114 rooms the lines show an agreement with another room and, after it, a P21 form that answers it: a member states that the agreement does not bind every placer ('we did have an agreement. Some of the people there just don't want to honor it', TheHulk-054), or refuses it ('/r/osu has officially teamed up ...' answered 'No', osu-036). In 48 rooms the P21 form comes first: in 35 at the making of terms, and in 13 in answer to an appeal or complaint with no agreement in force (the bound, a later line); 1 room shows both. 36 restrict lines are accepted corrections in two families that lift mostly to T3-010 under T4-016, so section 2 was triggered and A21 was re-examined in this leg. The alignment is substantive: the disclaimers and requests belong to the making of terms. A21's order holds for the limit and the refusal, so it stands with that bound rather than being withdrawn. The first-concept test on T3-126 (both 11, holds 10, null p95 0.909) is too thin to decide; the census of the rulings carries the count. No finding touches A21.
